v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Quæ est ista, * speciósa sicut colúmba, quasi rosa plantáta super rivos aquárum?
text.en: Who is this, * fair as a dove, like a rose-tree planted beside the rivers of waters?

text.la: Virgo potens, * sicut turris David: mille clípei pendent ex ea, omnis armatúra fórtium.
text.en: A virgin most mighty, * like the tower of David, whereon there hung a thousand bucklers, all the shields of valiant men.

text.la: Ave, María, * grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus.
text.en: Hail Mary, * full of grace, the Lord is with thee, blessed art thou among women.

text.la: Benedíxit te Dóminus * in virtúte sua, quia per te ad níhilum redégit inimícos nostros.
text.en: The Lord hath blessed thee * by His power, because through thee He hath brought our enemies to nought.

text.la: Vidérunt eam * fíliæ Sion vernántem in flóribus rosárum, et beatíssimam prædicavérunt.
text.en: The daughters of Sion saw her in her spring time, amidst the flowers of the roses, and called her most blessed.

text.la: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, séntiant omnes tuum iuvámen, quicúmque célebrant tuam sacratíssimi Rosárii solemnitátem.
text.en: Blessed Mother * and Inviolate Maiden, Glorious Queen of the World, may all that keep the solemn Feast of thy Most Holy Rosary feel the might of thine assistance.

text.la: Deus, cuius Unigénitus per vitam, mortem et resurrectiónem suam nobis salútis ætérnæ prǽmia comparávit: concéde, quǽsumus; ut hæc mystéria sacratíssimo beátæ Maríæ Vírginis Rosário recoléntes, et imitémur quod cóntinent, et quod promíttunt, assequámur.
text.en: O God, Whose only-begotten Son, by His life, death and resurrection, has merited for us the grace of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that, meditating upon those mysteries in the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise.
